about: Verdicts of claude-opus-5-5 on source against tree for awaab-collection (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: One two-line heading is split into two separate headings, so the text sits under a heading fragment.
findings.evidence: source: "Case-management has emerged as a best-practice approach for dealing with complex hazards but is resource dependent" / tree: "...for dealing with" + "complex hazards but is resource dependent"

findings.problem: The top table (monetised, non-monetised and distributional impacts) is read as running text in Paragraph 9, with row labels cut short and the ratings split off into separate notes.
findings.evidence: tree: "Non-monetised There are significant positive...", "Any significant There are likely..."; notes "Monetised impacts", "Negative", "impacts", "Positive"

findings.problem: Rating cells and row label fragments of the top table become stand-alone notes with no link to their rows.
findings.evidence: source: "Negative Based on likely £NPSV" beside "Monetised impacts" / tree: note-9 title "Negative" text "Based on likely £NPSV"
